semantics.override_metric: Unchanged union: lane rejection OR abs(requested-filtered)>1e-4 OR observed abs(filtered-realized)>0.05. Active-agent decision denominator.
semantics.native_sign: filtered-realized > 0 is a native reduction; < 0 is a native increase.
semantics.runs: Consecutive native-change decisions for the same vehicle within one episode at configured control dt. Missing vehicles, gaps, non-policy frames and episode boundaries end a run. Duration is decisions*dt.
semantics.target: The logged feasible target is an analytical/SUMO-ACC prediction computed before action. Association with measured realization is not proof of native controller cause.
semantics.prediction: Diagnostic min(filtered,target) model only; no action is changed and no acceptance threshold is relaxed.
semantics.unknown: Journals do not contain full input observations, exact car-following mode, gap/TTC or reasons for native safety intervention. Near-collision labels cannot be inferred.
semantics.correlation: Pearson correlation across recorded decisions is descriptive, temporally dependent and not causal; it is not a significance test.
